Shloka 1:1

धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सव: ।

मामका: पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥ १ ॥

dharma-kshetre kuru-kshetre samaveta yuyutsavah

mamakah pandavas chaiva kim akurvata sanjaya

Translation

Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do after gathering at the holy place of Kurukshetra, desiring to fight?

Commentary on Shloka 1:1

Kedi: What is the meaning of Bhagavad Gita Chapter 1, Verse 1?

Shloka 2:1

तं तथा कृपयाविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् ।

विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः ॥ १ ॥

tam tatha kripayavishtam ashrupurnakulekshanam

vishidantam idam vakyam uvacha madhusudanah

Translation

Sanjaya said: Seeing Arjuna overwhelmed with compassion, his eyes filled with tears and his mind deeply troubled by grief, Lord Krishna spoke these words to him.

Commentary on Shloka 2:1

Kedi: What is the meaning of Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2, Verse 1?

Ganesh: Sanjaya is telling Dhritarashtra that, seeing Arjuna overwhelmed with compassion, his eyes filled with tears and his mind deeply disturbed by grief, Lord Krishna spoke these words to him.

Shloka 3:1

अर्जुन उवाच
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन ।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥ १ ॥

arjuna uvacha
jyayasi chet karmanas te mata buddhir janardana
tat kim karmani ghore mam niyojayasi keshava

Translation

Arjuna said: O Janardana, if You consider knowledge to be superior to action, then why do You ask me, O Keshava, to engage in this terrible act of war?

item.title: Bhagavad Gita — Chapter 5: Karma Sannyasa Yoga
item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

5:1 5:2 5:3 5:4 5:5 5:6 5:7 5:8 5:9 5:10 5:11 5:12 5:13 5:14 5:15 5:16 5:17 5:18 5:19 5:20 5:21 5:22 5:23 5:24 5:25 5:26 5:27 5:28 5:29

Shloka 5:1

अर्जुन उवाच ।

संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि ।

यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम् ॥ ५:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha

sannyasam karmanam krishna punar yogam cha shamsasi

yac chreya etayor ekam tan me bruhi sunishchitam

Translation

Arjuna said: O Krishna, You praise the renunciation of actions and also the path of yoga (selfless action). Tell me decisively which of these two is better.

Shloka 6:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच । अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः । स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥ ६:१ ॥

shri bhagavan uvacha anashritah karma-phalam karyam karma karoti yah sa sannyasi cha yogi cha na niragnir na chakriyah

Translation

The Blessed Lord said: One who performs the action that ought to be done without depending on the fruits of action is a true renunciant and a yogi, not one who merely gives up sacred fire or abandons action.

item.description:

Shloka 7:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥ ७:१ ॥

shri bhagavan uvacha
mayy asakta-manah partha yogam yunjan mad-ashrayah
asamshayam samagram mam yatha jnasyasi tac chrinu

Translation

The Blessed Lord said: O Partha, listen to how, with your mind attached to Me and taking refuge in Me while practicing yoga, you shall know Me completely and without doubt.

item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

8:1 8:2 8:3 8:4 8:5 8:6 8:7 8:8 8:9 8:10 8:11 8:12 8:13 8:14 8:15 8:16 8:17 8:18 8:19 8:20 8:21 8:22 8:23 8:24 8:25 8:26 8:27 8:28

Shloka 8:1

अर्जुन उवाच ।
किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥ ८:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha
kim tad brahma kim adhyatmam kim karma purushottama
adhibhutam cha kim proktam adhidaivam kim uchyate

Translation

Arjuna said: O Supreme Person, what is Brahman? What is the Self (Adhyatma)? What is Karma? What is declared to be Adhibhuta, and what is called Adhidaiva?

item.title: Bhagavad Gita — Chapter 9: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga
item.description:

Shloka 9:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥ ९:१ ॥

shri bhagavan uvacha
idam tu te guhyatamam pravakshyamy anasuyave
jnanam vijnana-sahitam yaj jnatva mokshyase ‘shubhat

Translation

The Supreme Lord said: To you, who are free from envy, I shall reveal the most confidential knowledge along with its realization. By knowing this, you shall be freed from all inauspiciousness.

Shloka 10:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १०:१ ॥

shri bhagavan uvacha
bhuya eva maha-baho shrinu me paramam vachah
yat te ‘ham priyamanaya vakshyami hita-kamyaya

Translation

The Supreme Lord said: Once again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, hear My supreme words. Because you are dear to Me, I shall speak for your benefit.

Shloka 11:1

अर्जुन उवाच ।
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥ ११:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha
madanugrahaya paramam guhyam adhyatma-sanjnitam
yat tvayoktam vachas tena moho ‘yam vigato mama

Translation

Arjuna said: By Your grace, You have spoken to me the supreme confidential spiritual knowledge. By hearing these words, my illusion has now been dispelled.

Commentary

Shloka 11:2

अर्जुन उवाच ।
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥ ११:२ ॥

item.title: Bhagavad Gita — Chapter 12: Bhakti Yoga
item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

12:1 12:2 12:3 12:4 12:5 12:6 12:7 12:8 12:9 12:10 12:11 12:12 12:13 12:14 12:15 12:16 12:17 12:18 12:19 12:20

Shloka 12:1

अर्जुन उवाच । एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते । ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥ १२:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha evam satata-yukta ye bhaktas tvam paryupasate ye capy aksaram avyaktam tesam ke yoga-vittamah

Translation

Arjuna said: Those devotees who are always steadfast and worship You with devotion, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest Absolute—which of them is considered more perfect in yoga?

Commentary

item.description:

Shloka 13:1

अर्जुन उवाच । प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव ॥ १३:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha prakrtim purusam caiva ksetram ksetra-jnam eva ca etad veditum icchami jnanam jneyam ca kesava

Translation

Arjuna said: O Keshava, I desire to understand Prakriti (material nature), Purusha (the individual soul), the field (Kshetra), the knower of the field (Kshetrajna), as well as knowledge and the object of knowledge.

item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

Shloka 14:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥ १४:१ ॥

śrī-bhagavān uvāca
paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam
yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ

Translation

The Supreme Lord said: I shall once again declare to you the highest of all knowledge. By knowing this, all the sages have attained the supreme perfection.

Conversation

item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

15:1 15:2 15:3 15:4 15:5 15:6 15:7 15:8 15:9 15:10 15:11 15:12 15:13 15:14 15:15 15:16 15:17 15:18 15:19 15:20

Shloka 15:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच -
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् ।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥ १५:१ ॥

shri-bhagavan uvacha
urdhva-mulam adhah-shakham ashvattham prahur avyayam
chandamsi yasya parnani yas tam veda sa veda-vit

Translation

The Supreme Lord said: They speak of an eternal Ashvattha (banyan) tree with its roots above and branches below. Its leaves are the Vedic hymns. One who truly understands this tree is the knower of the Vedas.

item.title: Bhagavad Gita — Chapter 16: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga
item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

16:1 16:2 16:3 16:4 16:5 16:6 16:7 16:8 16:9 16:10 16:11 16:12 16:13 16:14 16:15 16:16 16:17 16:18 16:19 16:20 16:21 16:22 16:23 16:24

Shloka 16:1

श्रीभगवानुवाच - अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः । दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥ १६:१ ॥

shri-bhagavan uvacha abhayam sattva-samshuddhir jnana-yoga-vyavasthitih danam damash cha yajñash cha svadhyayas tapa arjavam

Translation

The Supreme Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in the pursuit of knowledge and spiritual wisdom, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of the sacred scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness—these are the divine qualities of those endowed with a godly nature.

item.title: Bhagavad Gita — Chapter 17: Shraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga
item.description:
✦ Shlokas ✦

17:1 17:2 17:3 17:4 17:5 17:6 17:7 17:8 17:9 17:10 17:11 17:12 17:13 17:14 17:15 17:16 17:17 17:18 17:19 17:20 17:21 17:22 17:23 17:24 17:25 17:26 17:27 17:28

Shloka 17:1

अर्जुन उवाच - ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः । तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः ॥ १७:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha ye shastra-vidhim utsrijya yajante shraddhayanvitah tesham nishtha tu ka krishna sattvam aho rajas tamah

Translation

Arjuna said: Those who, setting aside the injunctions of the scriptures, worship with sincere faith—what is the nature of their faith, O Krishna? Is it characterized by Sattva (goodness), Rajas (passion), or Tamas (ignorance)?

item.description:

Shloka 18:1

अर्जुन उवाच -
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन ॥ १८:१ ॥

arjuna uvacha
sannyasasya maha-baho tattvam icchami veditum
tyagasya cha hrishikesha prithak keshi-nishudana

Translation

Arjuna said: O mighty-armed Krishna, I desire to understand the truth of Sannyasa (renunciation) and also of Tyaga (relinquishment), O Hrishikesha, O slayer of Keshi.

Commentary

Kedi: What is the meaning of this verse of the Bhagavad Gita?
